testcase.name: M01 no observed interval means no summary and no invented value
M02 irregular intervals weight each measured metric, not sample counts
M02 simultaneous bad metrics count union time only once
M03 UTC wall minute boundary splits observed time exactly
M03 gaps and missing metrics never inflate the observed denominator
M03 absence/background remain distinct and do not invent prior presence
M04 copies clock/calibration/method/interval values and deeply freezes returned summaries
M04 close destroys incomplete aggregates; later calls cannot resurrect values
